title: Fauvist Marker
description: Un style d'illustration libre et expressif utilisant de larges coups de pinceau au feutre ou à la gouache dans une palette très restreinte. Les formes sont définies par l'espace négatif et des lavis translucides de couleurs vives plutôt que par des contours stricts.
description_en: A loose, expressive illustration style using broad marker or gouache brushstrokes in a highly restricted palette. Forms are defined by negative space and overlapping translucent washes of bold color rather than strict outlines.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration libre et expressif utilisant de larges coups de pinceau au feutre ou à la gouache dans une palette très restreinte. Les formes sont définies par l'espace négatif et des lavis translucides de couleurs vives plutôt que par des contours stricts.
prompt: Loose, expressive marker and gouache illustration. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space, no borders, no frames, full bleed to all four corners. The color science relies on a highly restricted, high-contrast palette dominated by {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}, punctuated by splashes of {{accent_color}}. The unpainted white paper acts as the foundational base, actively defining highlights, structural gaps, and negative space. Rendering features broad, flat, translucent brushstrokes that pool slightly at their limits. Overlapping strokes create darker intersections and multiplicative blending effects. There are no strict black outlines; instead, forms are built entirely from blocks of color and organic, wobbly brush marks. Graphic, stylized lighting treats shadows as solid, flat shapes of {{secondary_color}} or {{primary_color}} rather than volumetric gradients. Subtle cold-pressed paper grain is visible beneath the washes. The spatial dynamics rely on a flattened, somewhat naive perspective, compressing depth into graphic layers of vibrant hue. Atmospheric perspective is ignored in favor of stark, high-contrast color blocking. The emotional register is vibrant and spontaneous, capturing a fleeting moment through rapid, confident mark-making. Elements interlock like a mosaic of wet media, with precise control over unpainted zones to separate overlapping objects. Edges are loose, ragged, and painterly, showing the physical drag of the brush. fauvist marker, loose gouache, negative space illustration, duotone palette, broad brushstrokes, translucent washes, stylized flat perspective, wet media, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Brushstrokes pop and shift slightly frame-by-frame, mimicking a hand-painted boiling effect, while elements slide smoothly in a flat, multiplane parallax.
video.camera: Static or slow, steady lateral pans that maintain the flattened, graphic 2D perspective.
video.temporal_texture: The paper grain remains static while the translucent color washes exhibit a gentle, rhythmic flickering in their opacity and edge pooling.
video.avoid: Smooth 3D CGI rotations, volumetric lighting shifts, motion blur, and perfectly rigid vector outlines.
